instruction: Post a question about the last sweater I ordered on amazon, "Are there any specific detergents or products you recommend for preserving colors?".
notes: Single-app task (amazon). Static init facts (latest-order-of-type, in-order, has-product-type) describe the world structure whose ids are unknown until looked up: show_orders reveals the id of the most recent order containing a sweater, show_order reveals the product id inside it, show_product verifies the product type, and write_product_question posts the exact question text. The runtime agent may need to page through show_orders / inspect several orders to find the latest one with a sweater; the plan abstracts that into one lookup per API. Only one ProductQuestion must be added (no other DB changes), so the goal is just the posted question plus task completion; complete_task takes the posted record (product, question) as non-API parameters and is called without an answer.
